notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
@ specifies which DNS server to query rather than the system default. Used to: query the target's authoritative NS directly (for AXFR attempts), test a specific public resolver (8.8.8.8, 1.1.1.1), or use an internal corporate DNS server (--dns-server in Nmap equivalent).

=== USE CASES ===
@target-ns: direct authoritative query, attempt AXFR. @8.8.8.8: bypass local resolver for clean public DNS answer. @internal-dns: internal DNS may resolve names not public-facing, revealing internal infrastructure.

=== CAUTION ===
Querying authoritative nameservers directly is more detectable than querying public resolvers — direct query appears in NS server logs. "Recursion requested but not available" = hitting an authoritative-only server.
